transcript.text: I reviewed the university's master research agreement and the controlling schedule they supplied overnight. I confirmed that background patents U1, U2, and U3 are licensed to the company only for noncommercial academic use. The current draft grants the university an exclusive commercial license to all background technology, which would conflict with that restriction. The final agreement must exclude those three patents from any commercial license and require separate written university consent before any commercial use. I have not yet incorporated this into the draft or circulated the finding, so this is the first time the group is hearing it.
